title: Artifact: Post-Quantum Key Establishment After Standardization — benchmark scripts and raw measurement data
description: Benchmark scripts, raw measurement data, and analysis code for the paper "Post-Quantum Key Establishment After Standardization: An Experimental Comparison of ML-KEM, NTRU, HQC, and Classic McEliece" (A. Sohail, 2026). Includes liboqs CPU benchmarks on x86-64 and ARM, transport-level latency and packet-loss experiments for ephemeral KEM key exchange, real-WAN validation, complete TLS 1.3 and QUIC handshake measurements with the Open Quantum Safe provider, RAPL energy and massif memory profiles, statistical analysis with bootstrap confidence intervals, and the entropy-weighted TOPSIS selection framework. Code is MIT-licensed; measurement data is CC BY 4.0.
